Thanks for reaching out! Unfortunately, Trailforge does not offer price matching or post-purchase price adjustments. Per our promotions policy (kb/11-promotions.md), we do not offer price matching with other retailers, and our policies don't include a price adjustment program for items that go on sale after purchase.

If you'd like, you could return the jacket (if it meets the standard return conditions within 30 days of delivery) and repurchase it at the sale price — provided the item is unused, in its original packaging, and in resalable condition. You can find more details in our return policy (kb/01-return-policy.md).

Let me know if there's anything else I can help you with!
